PROCESS SIDE: cpmac_hw_error (715, work_struct callback, INIT_WORK 978) takes spin_lock(&priv->rx_lock) at 720 and calls cpmac_clear_rx (675) which walks and rewrites the entire rx descriptor ring under the lock; scheduled from cpmac_check_status at 759 out of the hardirq path and from cpmac_poll's fatal_error path at 528 (after napi_complete 523 and napi_disable 524). coverage_gaps: Tasklet/NAPI lock correlation was done by textual lock-expression base name per file; locks reached via differently named pointers, container_of aliases, or per-queue lock arrays between softirq and process sites could not be matched automatically.

Only the tasklet callback body plus the NAPI poll function and their same-file direct callees were treated as the softirq side; locks reached through deeper indirect calls (ops->, hw->, dmaops->, function-pointer tables, cross-file statics) were not resolved.

The ~200-file tasklet_init/tasklet_setup inventory (sound/, drivers/dma/, drivers/crypto/, drivers/mmc/, drivers/tty/, drivers/usb/, drivers/s390/, drivers/infiniband/, drivers/media/) was ranked by plain spin_lock density but only network-driver entries were deep-read; non-network tasklet bodies were not audited for a plain-spin_lock process partner.

NAPI poll registration was found via netif_napi_add/napi_schedule greps; polls registered in files where the schedule site lives elsewhere, and net core/protocol tasklet users (mac80211, can/bcm, dccp ccid2, tcp_output, iucv, rds), were not deep-read in this pass.

Process-context sites that disable BH via local_bh_disable() nesting or via a spin_lock_bh on an outer lock around a plain inner acquisition were only manually resolved for the classified candidates; the full tree was not audited for that pattern.
limitations: All findings are static hypotheses; no runtime reproducer or lockdep run was possible because the s10 snapshot has no .config or generated headers for building drivers standalone.

The cpmac finding is medium confidence because cpmac_poll's fatal_error path calls napi_disable before schedule_work and close cancels the work after napi_disable; residual exposure is the hardirq-scheduled reset_work (cpmac_check_status) and polls already executing when the worker runs.

The sc92031 finding is medium confidence because whether dev_watchdog runs with BH disabled was not proven from core source in this pass; the identical shape is high-confidence in sibling snapshot s03.

The cassini finding's open-side exposure (cas_open cas_spare_recover at 4265) is marginal because it runs before napi_enable; the primary live exposure is the cas_reset_task worker path at 4027 which is not napi-disabled.
mvneta, altera_tse, mwl8k and the ath5k txq->lock family were cleared only on the code paths read in this session; unexamined paths in those files may pair differently.
cxgb3/cxgb4 sge.c (highest remaining plain-spin_lock density among NAPI users) and tsi108_eth were left unresolved rather than audited to completion.
